item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - During intra-LTE HO procedure, the source eNodeB received UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME with a cause value other than 'Successful Handover', or 'Partial Handover', or 'CS Fallback triggered' or 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' or any cause code that is already covered by other screenings of this counter and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously. Note: 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' for MME is used to indicate the Double S1 described in screening 9 and screening 10. Since this cause is explicitly captured by those counts, it is excluded here to avoid double pegging/overlap. (80464-12)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseDuringIntraLteMobility

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection as a result of S1 Initial Context Setup procedure or incoming Handover, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost', and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously. (80464-10)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostAfterContextEstablished

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection as a result of S1 Initial Context Setup procedure or incoming Handover, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one established QCI1 E-RAB. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI1 E-RABs established. (80464-15)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostAfterContextEstablishedQCI1

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection as a result of S1 Initial Context Setup procedure or incoming Handover, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one established QCI2 E-RAB. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI2 E-RABs established. (80464-17)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostAfterContextEstablishedQCI2

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection as a result of S1 Initial Context Setup procedure or incoming Handover, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one established QCI5 E-RAB. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI5 E-RABs established. (80464-18)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostAfterContextEstablishedQCI5

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection as a result of S1 Initial Context Setup procedure or incoming Handover, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one established QCI8 E-RAB. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI8 E-RABs established. (80464-19)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostAfterContextEstablishedQCI8

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection as a result of S1 Initial Context Setup procedure or incoming Handover, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one established QCI9 E-RAB. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI9 E-RABs established. (80464-20)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostAfterContextEstablishedQCI9

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - Prior to the successful completion of the S1 Initial Context Setup procedure, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously. This screening and screening 10 are mutually exclusive. (80464-9)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostBeforeUEctxtEstablished

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - Prior to the successful completion of the S1 Initial Context Setup procedure, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one QCI1 E-RAB requested. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI1 E-RABs requested for initial setup. This screening and screening 15 are mutually exclusive. (80464-14)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostBeforeUEctxtEstablishedQCI1

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - Prior to the successful completion of the S1 Initial Context Setup procedure, UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND from MME is received with cause = 'Radio Connection with UE Lost' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent to MME previously and the UE has at least one QCI2 E-RAB requested. This screening is pegged multiple times if UE has more than one QCI2 E-RABs requested for initial setup. This screening and screening 17 are mutually exclusive. (80464-16)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.AbnormalReleaseRadioConnWithUELostBeforeUEctxtEstablishedQCI2

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - Cause received in UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND = 'Authentication Failure' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent previously. (80464-3)

item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.CsFallbackTriggered

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - After the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection, cause received in UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND = 'Detach' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent previously. (80464-7)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.DetachReleaseAfterS1APcnxEstablished

item.desc: This counter provides the number of UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND messages that have been received. - Prior to the successful establishment of the dedicated S1 connection, cause received in UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND = 'Detach' and no UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST has been sent previously. The dedicated S1 connection is considered established for the UE upon reception of this MME message, which also triggers the release of the S1 connection for the UE. This screening and screening 7 are mutually exclusive. (80464-4)
item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.DetachReleaseBeforeS1APcnxEstablished

item.name: VS.UEContextReleaseCommand.ReleaseWithOtherAbnormalCause

item.desc: Total number of DRB released - This counter provides the total number of abnormally released DRBs that were active at the time of release. DRBs with continuous flow are always seen as active DRBs in the context of this measurement. DRBs used in 3GPP option 3 are not covered in this measurement (90353)

item.desc: Number of Transmission octets on OAM type traffic - This counter provides the total number of transmission in octets for the OAM traffic. The total number of octets includes the application payload and IPsec protocol header (ESP) or (where IPsec is employed in tunnel mode) IPsec protocol header (ESP) and UDP+IP encapsulation headers. The application payload consists of the TCP payload, TCP header and IP header. The IPsec protocol (ESP) and UDP+IP encapsulation header octets are currently estimated. The estimated ESP overhead is 66 octets and (where IPsec is employed in tunnel mode, the ESP+UDP+IP overhead is estimated at 74 octets. (90226)
